title: Turns out,
your diabetes pill might be
behind that tingling in your hands and feet

items.name: Your Diabetes Medication
body: Ask your doctor for a B12 check,
and add salmon or eggs to your plate

items.name: Your Soda Habit
body: Swap one soda for sparkling water,
and take a walk after meals

items.name: Your Desk Chair
body: and uncross your legs when you notice

headline: If the tingling sticks around,
get checked by a doctor
These three changes are
a solid place to start
tip: A short walk, a B12-rich breakfast,
and less time sitting can add up
closing.cta: Want more health tips like this? Subscribe, like, and follow!
